title: 20th Century Limited Model Train Display Shelf Wall Mount HO Scale Track Wood
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Parts & Accessories:Other Parts & Accs
conditionDescription: Pre-owned display piece; finish clean with light handling marks. Track shows light surface rust/darkening on the rail tops and some dust between the ties. No cracks or breaks.
descriptionText:
Wall-mount model train display shelf with a brass "20TH CENTURY LIMITED" nameplate - named for the New York Central's famous Chicago-to-New York express. The shelf is a mahogany-finish molded base with a section of HO scale track fixed along the top, so a locomotive or car can sit on the rails as a wall display. The front face carries the engraved brass plate; the back is flat for mounting.

Measures approximately 25 1/2 inches long, about 2 1/2 inches deep and 1 1/2 inches tall; the track itself runs about 23 1/2 inches. A nice way to display a single HO engine or passenger car out of a display case. Shelf only - no train, no mounting hardware included.

Condition: Pre-owned display piece. The wood-look finish is clean with light handling marks, and the track shows some age with light surface rust/darkening on the rail tops and a little dust between the ties (see the close-up photos). No cracks or breaks. Please review all photos - they are of the actual shelf you will receive.
